purpose: Classify config, profile, and generated artifact ownership for program/data decoupling.

platform_common.description: Reusable simulation contracts, backend trait boundaries, and default policies.

domain_common.description: Radio transport / eCPRI-like domain defaults and model parameters.

project_specific.description: Project identity and selected simulation profiles.

runtime_generated.description: Benchmarks, metrics dumps, logs, traces, and CI artifacts.

local_machine_specific.description: Local tool paths and machine overrides; never commit secrets.

legacy_or_sample.description: Fixtures and sample configs for tests.

review_gate: any new persistent data path must map to a layer before merge
